safety.childSex: No chart can show whether a baby will be a boy or a girl, and in India finding out a baby's sex before birth isn't allowed by law. Every child is a blessing. If you like, ask me what the coming months look like for your family and home.
safety.partnerName: A chart can't show anyone's name or initial, so I won't guess one. What it can show is when love and marriage look more likely and what kind of partner suits you. Ask me about either.
safety.doctor: Please also see a doctor about this.
safety.lawyer: Please also talk to a lawyer about this.
safety.crisis: I'm really glad you told me. You don't have to carry this alone. Please talk to someone right now: call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (or 1-800-891-4416). It's free, open 24×7 and you can talk in your language. If you're in danger or might act on these thoughts, call 112 now. If you can, tell someone you trust and stay with them.
